text: Under Curry-Howard, the axiom of choice (AC) has a corresponding proof term in MLTT without extra axioms.
explanation: In MLTT, AC is provable: given Π(x:A).Σ(y:B).P(x,y), the choice function is λx.fst(f(x)). The witness is built in to the term. AC is not an axiom in dependent type theory — it follows from constructivity.
